destinations.name: Coober Pedy
destinations.coordinates_source: wikipedia:Coober Pedy (town point; re-pin to centre in pin stage)

name_evidence.source: Wikivoyage Coober Pedy; flindersandoutback.com.au/towns/coober-pedy; southaustralia.com Flinders Ranges and Outback
name_evidence.wording: opal-mining town with underground dugouts, the outback's main tourist stop on the Stuart Highway
remote Cooper Creek township, Burke and Wills country, gateway to Innamincka Regional Reserve and Coongie Lakes

spots.bio: Self-guided tour of a mine dug in 1916, with underground homes, in the opal-mining town of Coober Pedy.
spots.name: Old Timers Mine
spots.note: Wikivoyage See listing: self-guided tour of a 1916 mine and underground homes, a signature Coober Pedy visit (rule 2)

spots.bio: Underground opal mine, museum and dugout home showing how Coober Pedy's miners lived and worked.
spots.name: Umoona Opal Mine and Museum
spots.note: southaustralia.com region page names it; underground mine, museum and dugout, a main Coober Pedy attraction (rule 2)

spots.bio: Working opal mine with display seams that visitors tour underground, guided or self-guided.
spots.name: Tom's Working Opal Mine
spots.note: Wikivoyage Coober Pedy calls it 'the pick of the working mines' and Lonely Planet lists it as an attraction (display mine with opal seams, guided or self-guided tours); a place to go underground for an hour, not merely an operator. Objection: one of several Coober Pedy mine visits.

spots.bio: Colourful eroded desert hills called the Breakaways, about 33 km north of Coober Pedy.
spots.name: Kanku-Breakaways Conservation Park

spots.bio: Church bored out of solid rock, with a richly ornamented interior.
spots.wiki: Saint Elijah the Prophet Serbian Orthodox Church, Coober Pedy
spots.coordinates_source: wikipedia:Saint Elijah the Prophet Serbian Orthodox Church, Coober Pedy
spots.name: Saint Elijah the Prophet Serbian Orthodox Church
spots.note: Wikivoyage: church bored out of solid rock with a beautifully ornamented interior, a must see (church rule: interior named)

spots.bio: Tour of a hand-dug underground home in Coober Pedy.
spots.name: Faye's Underground Home
spots.note: Wikivoyage Coober Pedy See listing: tour of a hand-dug underground home, open daily except Sunday, $5 (rule 2)

spots.bio: Lunar-like desert plain south of Coober Pedy, used as a film location for Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome and Priscilla.
spots.name: Moon Plain
spots.note: Lonely Planet lists Moon Plain and southaustralia.com's region page names the lunar-like plain and film location (Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome, Priscilla) 15 km from Coober Pedy; a driving/walking sight on the Breakaways loop. Two counted sources.

spots.bio: Giant winch that doubles as a lookout over the Coober Pedy opal fields.
spots.name: Big Winch
spots.note: Wikivoyage See listing: lookout in the middle of Coober Pedy over the opal fields; a landmark Big Thing (rule 2,3)

spots.bio: Grassless desert golf course 3 km from Coober Pedy, where players carry a piece of turf to tee off.
spots.name: Coober Pedy Golf Club
spots.note: Wikivoyage names the grassless desert course (players carry a piece of turf to tee off) as a quirky thing to do 3 km from Coober Pedy; an open public course visitors play, a recognised quirky icon.

spots.bio: Reserve of 1.3 million hectares along Cooper Creek, with waterholes for fishing and canoeing.
spots.name: Innamincka Regional Reserve
spots.note: parks.sa.gov.au visitor page: 1.3 million ha reserve with Cooper Creek waterholes for fishing and canoeing, Cullyamurra Waterhole, the visitor centre and Burke and Wills sites; Flinders & Outback also names it. Objection: parts closed in floods and it overlaps Cullyamurra.

spots.bio: Australia's largest billabong on Cooper Creek, a canoeing and paddling spot significant to the Traditional Owners.
spots.name: Cullyamurra Waterhole
spots.note: Rule 1+2: Flinders & Outback (opened) names Australia's largest billabong as a canoe/paddle destination on Cooper Creek, significant to the Traditional Owners.

spots.bio: Arid-zone wetland of lakes and channels, reached by 4WD, for birdlife and canoeing.
spots.name: Malkumba–Coongie Lakes National Park
spots.note: Rule 1+2: Flinders & Outback park page (opened) calls it one of SA's most spectacular natural attractions: arid wetland, birds, canoeing; 4WD access. Keeps the Coongie Lakes duplicate as this one.
